note: Plugin gallery catalog (externalized from an in-page static array to the knowledge base channel starting in V2.2): all links point to the official GitHub repositories, and reachability is verified one by one before inclusion. v1.4 (full re-audit on 2026-09-26) ran three live checks on every entry - repository archived or not / last commit and release dates / whether a ready-made Windows package is available - and adjusted the list as follows: (1) removed 8 entries - spectralizer, obs-detect (repository archived), win-capture-audio, obs-dynamic-delay, obs-time-shift, obs-time-warp-scan, obs-device-switcher (long unmaintained with no release package), obs-recursion-effect; (2) corrected the ownership of 3 migrated repositories (occ-ai/* renamed to royshil/*); (3) added 8 active entries - Source Profiler, Record Rename, BILIBILI Stream, Branch Output, iOS Camera Source, MIDI MG, Shadertastic, Durchblick; (4) added the maintain / maintainNote fields: a commit or release within the past 12 months is marked active, older ones slow (explicitly flagging 'maintenance slowed' so users can judge whether it is worth installing). This file uses a separate hot-update channel identical to problems.json, so broken links or newly listed plugins can be fixed without a release. The dlls field is used by the 'local plugin health check' to match installed DLLs back to gallery entries (filename stem, lowercase, multiple aliases allowed; Lua script entries may be an empty array); aiCost* is filled in only for AI plugins, taken from each project's public overhead notes in its README. The live-check basis for every entry in this version is in docs/PLUGIN_AUDIT_2026-09.md.

plugins.name: OBS Helper (Dock)
plugins.desc: The official OBS dock panel plugin for this app (native C++ / Qt6): four tabs - health check, log analysis, settings audit, and system info - matched offline against the official Log Analyzer rule set, with one-click disabling of the 'culprit plugin'.

plugins.name: Scene Notes Dock
plugins.desc: Attach a separate notes board to each scene: jot down cues, flow, and to-dos, and it follows the scene automatically when you switch.

plugins.name: Face Tracker
plugins.desc: Automatic face-tracking: the camera smoothly pans, zooms, and centers as the person moves - great for walk-and-talk tutorials, unboxings, and multi-camera directing.

plugins.name: PTZ Controls
plugins.desc: Control PTZ cameras directly inside OBS: move to preset positions and link zoom to scene changes - essential for meeting recordings and multi-camera streaming.

plugins.name: RTSP Server
plugins.desc: Turn the OBS output into an RTSP server: VLC, phones, and another computer on the LAN can all pull the stream to monitor it.
plugins.maintainNote: Last commit 2024-01 - no equivalent alternative yet, still usable

plugins.name: Zoom to Mouse
plugins.desc: Lua script (no DLL required): Display Capture smoothly zooms to follow the mouse - the 'smart director' for tutorials and demos. Pick either this or Zoominator.
plugins.maintainNote: Last commit 2024-06 - no equivalent alternative yet, still usable

plugins.name: Advanced Scene Switcher
plugins.desc: Macro-driven scene automation: automatically switch scenes, start recording, and send requests based on window focus, audio levels, timers, and streaming platform events.

plugins.name: Move Transition
plugins.desc: On scene switch, sources pan and scale along easing curves, turning hard cuts into camera moves at very low cost.

plugins.name: Transition Table
plugins.desc: Assign a dedicated transition to any pair of scenes, replacing a single global transition.

plugins.name: Downstream Keyer
plugins.desc: Overlay logos, banners, and score bugs on top of every scene without adding them scene by scene.

plugins.name: Scene Collection Manager
plugins.desc: Automatic backup and snapshot management for Scene Collections, with one-click rollback after a mistake.

plugins.name: Source Switcher
plugins.desc: Automatically cycle through a group of sources on a timer, hotkey, or condition - good for multi-camera setups and ad rotation.

plugins.name: Media Controls
plugins.desc: A standalone control panel: play / pause / seek all Media Sources, so you don't hunt through scenes for buttons while directing.

plugins.name: URL Source
plugins.desc: Pull data from a URL / API to generate text or images: stock prices, scores, weather, and danmaku APIs can all go on screen.

plugins.name: obs-shaderfilter
plugins.desc: Load custom shaders on any source: vignette, RGB split, pixelation, VHS, and more, with plenty of built-in examples.

plugins.name: Composite Blur
plugins.desc: High-quality blur filter, with a Dual Kawase mode that is both fast and clean; the blur replacement after StreamFX stopped updating.

plugins.name: Advanced Masks
plugins.desc: Shape / gradient / image masks - essential for rounded webcam frames and custom-shaped visuals.

plugins.name: Stroke Glow Shadow
plugins.desc: Stroke, glow, and shadow in one, giving webcam feeds and text a polished look in seconds.

plugins.name: Gradient Source
plugins.desc: A gradient source for backgrounds, transition color cards, or mask assets.

plugins.name: Source Clone
plugins.desc: Clone the same source with different filters: one webcam can output a clean version, a picture-in-picture, and a vertical crop at once.

plugins.name: Freeze Filter
plugins.desc: Freeze a source's current frame with one click: a fuse that keeps a presentable image during dropouts and switch gaps.
plugins.maintainNote: Last commit 2025-07 - no equivalent alternative yet, still usable

plugins.name: Retro Effects
plugins.desc: CRT / VHS / glitch-art retro effects with far less overhead than comparable shader approaches.

plugins.name: Background Removal
plugins.desc: AI keying for a virtual green screen, no physical green cloth needed, runs on CPU / GPU.

plugins.name: LocalVocal
plugins.desc: Local real-time speech-to-text plus translated subtitles, supporting over a hundred languages, with data never leaving your machine.

plugins.name: CleanStream
plugins.desc: AI noise reduction that filters out keyboard clatter and background hum while keeping vocals clean.

plugins.name: Auto Subtitle
plugins.desc: iFlytek speech recognition for real-time Chinese subtitles, with stable direct connections on mainland networks - the top choice for Chinese live captions.
plugins.aiCostCpu: Very low overhead (cloud recognition, local audio capture only)
plugins.maintainNote: Last commit 2024-12 - no equivalent alternative yet, still usable

plugins.name: Audio Monitor
plugins.desc: Monitor audio per source or route it to different output devices - essential for two-camera and interview setups.

plugins.name: Tuna
plugins.desc: 'Now Playing': grab the track title and cover art from a media player to generate an overlay bar.

plugins.name: Waveform
plugins.desc: High-precision real-time audio waveform visualization, with multi-channel and customizable styling - more detailed than a spectrum.

plugins.name: Aitum Vertical
plugins.desc: A second canvas for vertical video: stream and record horizontal and vertical at once, with bound scenes switching in sync.

plugins.name: Aitum Multistream
plugins.desc: Stream to multiple platforms from one OBS, with independent bitrate and settings per output, actively maintained.

plugins.name: obs-multi-rtmp
plugins.desc: A long-standing multi-destination streaming plugin with a large install base; on newer OBS versions, evaluate Aitum Multistream first.
plugins.riskNote: Note: sporadic reports on newer OBS of bandwidth drops / Encoding overload / antivirus false positives; switch to Aitum Multistream if multiple outputs are unstable

plugins.name: DistroAV (formerly obs-ndi)
plugins.desc: Low-latency audio and video send/receive over the LAN - infrastructure for two-machine setups and remote directing.

plugins.name: Teleport
plugins.desc: A lightweight NDI alternative: push the camera feed from a phone or another computer into OBS over the LAN.

plugins.name: Source Dock
plugins.desc: Project any source into a standalone window: monitor the webcam / game footage on a second screen, a desktop-directing workflow.

plugins.name: Spout2 Input/Output
plugins.desc: Spout2 GPU texture sharing: send and receive frames losslessly with visual software like TouchDesigner and Resolume.

plugins.name: Source Record
plugins.desc: Record individual sources on their own: a clean face track, a game-only track - no more cutting them out in post.
plugins.riskNote: Note: older versions can get stuck on 'stopping recording' with some OBS setups; if it happens, update to the latest version first

plugins.name: Source Copy
plugins.desc: Copy and paste sources and filter settings between scenes - a time-saver when building complex scenes.

plugins.name: Replay Source
plugins.desc: Instant replay from the Replay Buffer: replay the moment you just had with one click for matches and highlights.

plugins.name: Input Overlay
plugins.desc: Show keyboard, mouse, and gamepad input in sync on the stream - common in game tutorials and challenge content.

plugins.name: DroidCam OBS
plugins.desc: Turn an Android / iOS phone into a wireless camera source.

plugins.name: Zoominator
plugins.desc: The whole scene smoothly zooms to follow the mouse - the 'smart director' for tutorials and demos.

plugins.name: Soundboard
plugins.desc: Hotkey soundboard: bind sound effects, canned laughter, and meme audio to keys for one-press triggering - great for spicing up interactive streams.
plugins.maintainNote: Last commit 2025-06 - no equivalent alternative yet, still usable

plugins.name: Countdown Timer
plugins.desc: A professional countdown source for stream-start countdowns, giveaways, and Subathon timers, with pause/resume and custom text formatting.

plugins.name: Scale to Sound
plugins.desc: Volume-driven scaling: your webcam bounces and grows with your voice, giving a 'breathing' camera without motion-graphics software.
plugins.maintainNote: Last commit 2025-07 - no equivalent alternative yet, still usable

plugins.name: 3D Effect
plugins.desc: 3D transform filter: perspective rotate, tilt, and flip a webcam or any source; the recommended replacement after StreamFX stopped updating.

plugins.name: Browser Transition
plugins.desc: HTML animation transitions: use web animation files for scene-switch effects, with a huge library of free community transition assets ready to use.

plugins.name: HTML Source
plugins.desc: Render local HTML/CSS/JS as a source: lighter than a Browser Source for animated lower thirds and data dashboards, with live refresh.

plugins.name: Color Monitor
plugins.desc: Broadcast-grade scopes: waveform, vectorscope, and histogram - the professional basis for color grading and exposure calibration.

plugins.name: Source Profiler
plugins.desc: Per-source performance analysis: measures the CPU / GPU time share of each source and filter, putting 'who is eating performance' right on the table. Far faster than disabling sources one by one when troubleshooting dropped frames and stutter.

plugins.name: Record Rename
plugins.desc: Automatically rename recording files after recording ends using rules (time, scene name, etc.), so long-session segment files are no longer a pile of timestamps and finding footage is much quicker.

plugins.name: BILIBILI Stream for OBS
plugins.desc: One-stop Bilibili streaming: scan to log in inside OBS, get the RTMP stream URL and Stream Key, and sync live-room info - no more repeatedly copying the Stream Key from the web dashboard.

plugins.name: Branch Output
plugins.desc: Give a single source its own RTMP / SRT output: while the main stage streams to a platform, send the webcam, guest feed, and so on separately to another machine or platform, without pushing a whole second copy.

plugins.name: iOS Camera Source
plugins.desc: Use an iPhone / iPad as an OBS video source: transmitted over a USB connection, with image quality and stability usually better than an ordinary webcam - good for adding a camera on short notice or shooting on the move.

plugins.name: MIDI MG
plugins.desc: Map MIDI controllers (mixers, drum pads, knobs) to OBS actions: faders for volume, buttons for scene switching - with a hardware panel on hand you don't need to buy a dedicated controller.

plugins.name: Shadertastic
plugins.desc: Add shader effects to a source: several ready-made effects are built in, and you can load custom shader files directly - styling a look is easier than writing effects from scratch.

plugins.name: Durchblick
plugins.desc: Modular multi-view monitoring: compose multiple scenes / sources into a single multi-grid output - see the whole field for directing and meeting recordings, with more flexible layouts than the built-in multiview.
